# A calmer place to read

Solarized Light combines a warm paper background with muted blue-gray text.
Try **bold text**, *emphasis*, `inline code`, and a [link](https://example.com).

## Code and reading fonts

```rust
fn greeting(name: &str) -> String {
    let count = 42;
    // Comments, strings, and numbers follow the palette.
    format!("Hello, {name}! Count: {count}")
}
```

| Setting | Choice | Scope |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Color theme | Solarized Light | All windows |
| Text font | Georgia or Segoe UI | Proportional text |
| Code font | Consolas | Code and inline code |

> [!NOTE]
> Appearance choices last for the current session. No fonts are downloaded.

## Keep reading

Change the theme, select a text font, resize the window, and toggle the outline.
The document should remain readable and the text should stay selectable.
